scope: Deterministic estimators that turn declared synthetic patient-state fields into published-model covariates. An estimate is a calculation under stated assumptions, not a measured value.

creatinine_umol_per_mg_dl.meaning: Serum creatinine unit conversion (umol/L per mg/dL), from creatinine molar mass 113.12 g/mol.

notes: Uses total body weight. Required by the Janmahasatian fat-free mass estimator.

fat_free_mass_janmahasatian.equation: MALE: FFM = 9270 * WT / (6680 + 216 * BMI); FEMALE: FFM = 9270 * WT / (8780 + 244 * BMI)

source.citation: Janmahasatian S, Duffull SB, Ash S, Ward LC, Byrne NM, Green B. Quantification of lean bodyweight. Clin Pharmacokinet. 2005;44(10):1051-1065.
source.source_status: equation_widely_reproduced; derivation-population limits not yet transcribed into this registry

notes: Hughes 2019 cites this method for FFM (Section 2.3, reference 40).
The control stream reads FFM as a precomputed data column; the exact implementation used to build that column is not published.

ideal_body_weight_devine.equation: MALE: IBW = 50 + 2.3 * (height_in - 60); FEMALE: IBW = 45.5 + 2.3 * (height_in - 60); height_in = height_cm / 2.54

source.citation: Devine BJ. Gentamicin therapy. Drug Intell Clin Pharm. 1974;8:650-655.
source.source_status: equation_widely_reproduced; originally an empirical dosing convention, not a body-composition measurement

notes: Below 60 inches (152.4 cm) the linear formula extrapolates below its base weight; this is flagged.
Used here only as a candidate Cockcroft-Gault weight basis.

source.citation: Conventional dosing-weight correction (commonly used with aminoglycoside dosing and Cockcroft-Gault in obesity).
source.source_status: convention; primary source not verified in this registry

notes: Applied as written for every patient. When TBW < IBW the result lies between them; practice conventions differ and none is assumed.

creatinine_clearance_cockcroft_gault.equation: CrCL_mL_min = (140 - age_years) * W / (72 * SCr_mg_dl) * (0.85 if FEMALE else 1); SCr_mg_dl = SCr_umol_l / 88.4

source.citation: Cockcroft DW, Gault MH. Prediction of creatinine clearance from serum creatinine. Nephron. 1976;16(1):31-41.

notes: The original paper does not settle which weight to use in obesity; the weight basis is a declared assumption on every estimate.
Derived in adult men with stable serum creatinine; the 0.85 female factor was proposed rather than derived from female measurements.
Assumes steady-state serum creatinine. Not meaningful for rapidly changing renal function.
Predates standardized (IDMS-traceable) creatinine assays; assay differences shift estimates.
Not indexed to body surface area. Never interchangeable with indexed eGFR.

boundaries: Estimators run only on synthetic educational patient states.
No unit conversion is performed on inputs other than the documented creatinine conversion inside Cockcroft-Gault.
An estimate does not make a model applicable. Model applicability is reviewed separately against source coverage.
